mapper.sql: wr.id, wr.project_id, p.name AS project_name, p.status AS project_status, wr.content, wr.occurred_at, wr.created_at, wr.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_records (id, project_id, content, occurred_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{content}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM work_records wr LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = wr.project_id WHERE wr.occurred_at >= #{start} AND wr.occurred_at < #{end} ORDER BY wr.occurred_at DESC, wr.created_at DESC
